role: offline characterization plus proposed acceptance gates; counterexamples remain unfixed
database: fresh TemporaryDirectory per test; removed after test

counterexamples.proposed_acceptance: Cancellation should be checked after response and before publication; do not claim immediate in-flight socket cancellation.
Keep pagination exhaustion separate from valid-data health/coverage; an all-invalid page is degraded, never ecological silence.
Absence from latest snapshot is not deletion; define explicit withdrawals and stale/hidden statuses without inventing tombstones.
Clear retry delay/deadline on a successful poll; do not present stale retry as active health.
Check cancellation before bootstrap and before every subsequent request.
Validate/document out-of-window policy; never infer freshness from last_success or invent publication lag.
